_comment: Single source of truth for the changeset gate. Both scripts/generate-changeset.mjs (local pre-push hook) and .github/workflows/changeset-gate.yml (CI gate) read this file. When this map changes, both consumers pick it up automatically. Keys are the shipping paths — patterns use minimatch syntax and every key must end in '/**'. Values name the npm package that publishes that path, so the gate can check that a changeset declares the package whose code the PR actually touched (VI-647). A null value means the path requires a changeset but no npm package publishes it, so no owner can be asserted — see _unowned.
_unowned: assets/** is README artwork and brand SVGs, listed in no package's `files` field. packages/visor-flutter/lib/** publishes to pub.dev, which changesets does not manage. Both still require a changeset for release-note visibility; neither can be cross-checked against a package name.
